title: Sliding puzzle game
slide_intent: Make a flexible mark physically manipulable because an identity’s defining behavior can become an experience people control.
strategic_value: Rearrangeable W fragments can turn Whitney’s geometric language into a playful retail object.
demonstration: Three white sliding puzzles show differently rearranged black line fragments and portions of Whitney.
practical_value: Compare a recognizable structure with its fragmented states when translating identity into an interactive object.

content_islands.name: Puzzle trio
content_islands.spec: Align three square sliding puzzles on the gray surface, retaining their differing tile arrangements.

reference_purposes.Application: The official launch caption identifies a puzzle game produced for the museum’s retail store.
